name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-1-pixel-id-unread
note: A new MapsFile pixel id written y-first would pass unseen.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-11-pixel-mask-unread
note: A MapId's low 20 bits used as an identity would pass unseen (C3, C4).

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-2-region-count-unread
note: A new bound by MAPS.BSA's region count would pass unseen.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-3-bay-bound-999-499-unread
note: A bound written as > 499 or <= 999 would pass unseen.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-12-bay-clamp-unread
note: A pixel clamped into the Bay would pass unseen.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-13-bay-bound-bare-xy-unread
note: A bound on a bare x or y (x >= 1000) would pass unseen (C5).

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-4-region-62-unread
note: A region bounded to the Bay's 62 would pass unseen.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-5-comments-counted
note: A comment that names the Bay's id would count as code.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-6-url-read-as-comment
old: return at >= 0 && !/:\s*$/.test(line.slice(0, at)) ? line.slice(0, at) : line;
note: The rest of a line after a URL's slashes would be dropped as a comment.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-7-marker-above-unread
note: A BAY-OWN: comment on the line above would not take the line out.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-8-unlisted-let-through
note: A file not in the baseline could add any number of idioms.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-9-stale-unread
note: A fix that removed an idiom would leave room for a new one.

name: TAMRIEL-WIDE-10-lowering-raises
note: --lower would raise a baseline to today's count.
